name: Videocall testing between two users - mute, unmute, fullscreen, expand/collapse call

steps.name: locator.getByText('Your request is making it\'s way!').waitFor
Second user uploads a profile picture
First user uploads a profile picture
Send message from second user to first user
Second user calls the first user
Validate user is connecting displays and then accept incoming call
Validate incoming call modal is closed
With second user validate contents from call screen
With first user validate contents from call screen
Validate user can unmute and mute the call
Validate user can deafen/undeafen the call
Validate user can start/stop sharing screen
Validate user can expand/collapse the call view
Executing full screen mode validations only on desktop viewport since exit button appears outside of mobile viewport
Validate user can enable/disable video during call
Validate user can open call volume mixer
Validate user can open/close call settings
Validate user can finish the call
